description: Public profiles with tournament history and visibility (plan.md decision 1, items 2.1-2.4). M1 defined activity in en.json `profile_show_activity` ('Show tournaments I'm registered for on my public profile'). Results (showResults) = tournaments the user played or plays (running/completed) with org, date (startsAt ?? createdAt), status, final rank and won-drawn-lost record, linking to the tournament and its matches page. Activity (showActivity) = registered-for tournaments that haven't started (registration/check_in) plus the user's organizations with role (not public anywhere else; the settings label is updated to say so). Hidden sections are left out in the service; the owner always sees everything with a 'Hidden from others.' note and a settings link. Linked accounts stay ungated as in M1. Depends on FEAT-001 only for the listUserTournaments fields (participantId, createdAt, game) it added; independent of FEAT-003..005.
steps: New src/lib/server/services/profiles.ts: `export interface MatchRecord { won: number; drawn: number; lost: number }`; pure `matchRecord(participantId: string, results: MatchResult[]): MatchRecord` (winner null -> drawn, entrants[winner] === participantId -> won, else lost); `getProfile(username: string, viewerId: string | null)` returning undefined for an unknown user, else `{ user: { username, displayName, bio, avatarUrl, createdAt }, isOwn, visibility: { results: user.showResults, activity: user.showActivity }, accounts, results, activity }` where accounts = listIdentities without 'dev', mapped to `{ module: getModule(id)?.name ?? id, username }` (moved from the page load); results = null unless isOwn || showResults, else listUserTournaments rows with status running/completed mapped to `{ orgSlug, orgName, slug, name, status, date: startsAt ?? createdAt, finalRank, game, record }` (one matches query: status 'completed' and participant1_id or participant2_id in the user's participant ids, `inArray` + `or`); activity = null unless isOwn || showActivity, else `{ tournaments: rows with status registration/check_in sorted soonest first, mapped to TournamentList items with detail: orgName, organizations: await listUserOrganizations(user.id) }`. Doc comment explaining the visibility rule. Drafts never appear (listUserTournaments excludes them).

New src/lib/server/services/profiles.db.spec.ts (patterns from tournaments.db.spec.ts: withPlayers, setStatus, startTournament, setMatchResult as organizer / playAll): SE of 4 to the end -> p1 rank 1 record {2,0,0}, p4 rank 3 {0,0,1}; SE of 3 -> the bye isn't counted; round robin of 3 with [1,1] results -> drawn counted; a running tournament is in results with finalRank null; a registration tournament is in activity.tournaments and not in results; a draft appears nowhere; organizations with role in activity; a dev identity isn't in accounts; with showResults=false and showActivity=false (update users directly or via updateProfile) an anonymous viewer (null) and another user get results/activity null, the owner gets data and visibility { results: false, activity: false }; unknown username -> undefined.

src/lib/format.ts: add `/** A match record as "2–0–1": won, drawn, lost. */ export const formatRecord = ({ won, drawn, lost }: { won: number; drawn: number; lost: number }) => `${won}–${drawn}–${lost}`;` (same en dash as formatScore).

src/routes/u/[username]/+page.server.ts: `const profile = await getProfile(params.username, locals.user?.id ?? null); if (!profile) error(404, m.error_user_not_found()); return profile;` (add key error_user_not_found 'User not found').

src/routes/u/[username]/+page.svelte: keep the header card ('member since' via `formatDate(data.user.createdAt, { year: 'numeric', month: 'long' })`, Edit profile for the owner). Grid (2fr 1fr as today): main = `

messages/en.json: profile_show_activity -> "Show the tournaments I'm registered for and my organizations on my public profile"; new keys user_activity 'Activity', user_registered 'Registered for', user_organizations 'Organizations', user_activity_empty 'Not registered for any upcoming tournament.', user_activity_hidden 'This user keeps their tournaments and organizations private.', user_hidden_note 'Hidden from others.', user_hidden_settings 'Change this in settings', user_matches_of 'Matches of {name}', user_history_tournament 'Tournament', user_history_organization 'Organization', user_history_date 'Date', user_history_status 'Status', user_history_rank 'Rank', error_user_not_found 'User not found' (names are suggestions; keep the existing user_results*, user_accounts, user_edit, user_member_since keys).

New e2e/profiles.e2e.ts (reuse helpers): organizer `signIn`, `createOrganization`, `createTournament(page, orgSlug, 'Profile Cup')`, 'Open registration', `registerPlayers(browser, path, 'pf', 4)`, 'Start tournament', `adminTab(page, 'Matches').click()`, `playReadyMatches(page)`, expect 'The tournament is finished.'; second tournament 'Next Cup' opened for registration and p1 registers via `playerPage`. Organizer on /u/<p1>: `getByRole('region', { name: 'Results' })` row contains 'Profile Cup', '#1', '2–0–0'; Activity region contains 'Next Cup'. p1 (playerPage) unchecks getByLabel('Show my results on my public profile'), Save, 'Profile saved.'; p1's /u/<p1> still shows 'Profile Cup' plus 'Hidden from others.' and a 'Change this in settings' link; organizer and a fresh logged-out context (`browser.newContext({ extraHTTPHeaders: { 'X-Forwarded-Proto': 'http' } })`) see 'This user keeps their results private.' and no 'Profile Cup'. Then the same for the activity checkbox (new label text) and 'Next Cup'. Close contexts.
README.md: short '## Profiles' section (what results and activity contain, both hideable in Settings, the owner always sees everything).
Record in `findings` what FEAT-005 needs for the PLAN.md notes.
acceptance_criteria: `corepack pnpm test:unit --run src/lib/server/services/profiles.db.spec.ts` passes and proves hidden sections are null for visitors and other users while the owner gets them.
Records count only completed matches (byes and unplayed matches excluded) and draws in round robin.

`e2e/profiles.e2e.ts` passes: the history row shows the final rank and record; with showResults off, another user and a logged-out visitor don't see it while the owner does with the 'Hidden from others.' note; the same for showActivity.
`corepack pnpm check` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings; no REST API change for user data.

API: `getProfile(username, viewerId | null)` -> undefined | { profile: { username, displayName, bio, avatarUrl, createdAt }, isOwn, visibility: { results, activity }, accounts: { module, username }[], results: { orgSlug, orgName, slug, name, status, date, finalRank, game, record }[] | null, activity: { tournaments: TournamentList items (detail = orgName), organizations: { slug, name, role }[] } | null }; pure exported `matchRecord(participantId, MatchResult[])` and `interface MatchRecord`. DEVIATION from plan: the header data key is `profile`, not `user`, because page data named `user` would shadow the root layout's `user` (signed-in user) in page.data; the page keeps using `data.profile`. Reused: m.user_results*, m.standings_record, m.participants_rank, m.t_matches (also as a visually-hidden for the link column), m.members_role_owner/admin. Page: sections use aria-labelledby (results-title, activity-title, accounts-title) so e2e addresses them as regions 'Results'/'Activity'; owner note `

` via a snippet; member since via formatDate(…, { year: 'numeric', month: 'long' }) (getLocale import removed). FEAT-004 note: the profile page's own UI strings are all in en.json already; the remaining English in profile-related code is users.ts profileSchema Zod messages. Verified: corepack pnpm format; check 0 errors/0 warnings; lint passes; test:unit --run 31 files / 361 tests pass; test:e2e e2e/profiles.e2e.ts e2e/auth.e2e.ts 3 passed. For PLAN.md M8 notes: profiles are UI-only (no REST API change for user data); hidden sections are filtered in services/profiles.ts so their data never reaches page data; records count only `completed` matches (byes, waiting/ready and skipped excluded), draws count as drawn; date = startsAt ?? createdAt; activity reuses showActivity for organization membership (no schema change).
